title: polygala nicaeensis subsp. gariodiana
intro: Polygala nicaeensis subsp. gariodiana, commonly known as Nicaean Milkwort, is a plant species in the family Polygalaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The health benefits of Polygala nicaeensis subsp. gariodiana include its expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and promote the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
